Wigglytuff (Japanese: プクリン Pukurin) is the big sister of , who appeared in Magical Pokémon Journey.

==History==
Wigglytuff and her little sister live in a mansion with many Jigglypuff maids and as their butler.

Wigglytuff is 's girlfriend as he fell in love with her in Even an Arbok Falls in Love!.

==Personality and characteristics==
Wigglytuff is considered a leader figure towards Jigglypuff since she is older.
